title: I Don’t Fully Understand
summary: I get confused about how Buddhism works sometimes. Honestly.
blocks: I don’t fully understand. I get confused about how Buddhism works sometimes. Honestly. I am conditioned as a Christian and my understanding of God seems clear, especially regarding praying and how the events in life unfold. I hope I can come to understand Buddhism more, for myself; especially the practice of forgiveness when no one is around. This is a grueling and arduous, painstaking process of individual development & transformation.
_source_note: Josh's own words, dated 21/08/2026 16:40 UK time, published verbatim. Title and summary drawn from his opening lines; nothing added, softened or reworded.
